items.title: The Knicks haven't merely beaten Brooklyn and Toronto 30 consecutive times.
items.author: Tommy Beer
items.body_excerpt:
The Knicks haven't merely beaten Brooklyn and Toronto 30 consecutive times. 

They've outscored them by a staggering 462 points in those contests.

That's an average margin of victory of 15.4 points per game.

quote.author: Tommy Beer
quote.text:
Knicks’ record in the 30 games they’ve played against the Nets and the Raptors over the past three years:

30-0

​Yes, New York is 15-0 against both Toronto and Brooklyn, dating back to January of 2023.

items.title: November 19, 1983: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar becomes the 2nd player ever to score 30,000 career NBA points.
items.author: NBA Cobwebs
items.body_excerpt:
November 19, 1983: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar becomes the 2nd player ever to score 30,000 career NBA points.

Abdul-Jabbar finished with 20 PTS in the Lakers’ 117-110 win at Portland.  Wilt Chamberlain was the first NBA player to score 30,000 PTS.
